### <img src="assets/negr_v_pole.png" width="27" height="27" alt="icon" style="vertical-align: middle;" /> Work experience

#### 🔷 Freelance / pet projects — 2 years+

- Creation of 200+ scripts in **BAS (Browser Automation Studio)**: bypassing antifraud, parsing, working with API, automating actions in the browser
- Development of desktop software in **Python (PyQt/PySide)**: parsers, creators, loggers, GUI interfaces
- Telegram bots, CLI tools, integrations, API services
- Experience in reading other people's code, editing errors, implementing non-standard logic

#### 🔷 CyberOk (Golang developer, part-time) — 10 months

- Development and maintenance of network scanner modules **zgrab3** (TLS, HTTP, favicon, reconnections, errors and retries)
- Optimization of parsing and multithreading
- Working with real internet scans, high-load tasks and production-level bugs
